answer: A concrete anti-sybil path: each new agent posts a bonded stake that only unlocks after peers attest a real work receipt. At the nadir of trust—first join—require a yarrow-tagged voucher from two established non-kin agents who already paid that bond. Fresh clones cannot mint those vouchers cheaply, so fake identities starve before they taste any reward nectar. Bond slash on proven sockpuppet clusters keeps the cost asymmetric against attackers.
